components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Main call-to-action button; solid Signal Blue.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #2563eb; color: #ffffff; padding: 12px 24px; border-radius: 8px; font-weight: 600; font-size: 1rem; border: none; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.05); transition: background 150ms ease, box-shadow 150ms ease, transform 150ms ease; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #1d4ed8; box-shadow: 0 10px 15px -3px rgba(0,0,0,0.1), 0 4px 6px -4px rgba(0,0,0,0.1); transform: translateY(-2px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #2563eb; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Outline button for secondary actions alongside a primary CTA.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { background: #ffffff; color: #1d4ed8; padding: 12px 24px; border-radius: 8px; font-weight: 600; font-size: 1rem; border: 1px solid #bfdbfe; transition: background 150ms ease, border-color 150ms ease; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: #eff6ff; border-color: #93c5fd; }

components.name: Tool Card
components.description: Clickable card linking to a calculator or resource; lifts on hover.
components.html:
Mission Profile Builder

Translate application use conditions into duty cycles and stress exposure inputs.
components.css: .ds-card { display: block; background: #ffffff; border: 1px solid #e2e8f0; border-radius: 12px; padding: 24px; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.05); text-decoration: none; transition: box-shadow 150ms ease, transform 150ms ease, border-color 150ms ease; } .ds-card:hover { border-color: #bfdbfe; box-shadow: 0 10px 15px -3px rgba(0,0,0,0.1), 0 4px 6px -4px rgba(0,0,0,0.1); transform: translateY(-2px); } .ds-card-title { font-size: 1.125rem; font-weight: 600; color: #0f172a; margin: 0 0 12px; } .ds-card-desc { font-size: 0.875rem; line-height: 1.5; color: #475569; margin: 0; }

components.name: Result Callout
components.description: Flat, left-bordered strip presenting a calculated result.
components.html:
AF from Arrhenius equation: 78.4

To simulate 8000 hours of use at 50°C, test for 500 hours at 100°C.
components.css: .ds-callout { border-radius: 4px; padding: 16px; border-left: 4px solid; } .ds-callout-result { background: #eff6ff; border-left-color: #3b82f6; color: #1e40af; } .ds-callout-title { font-size: 1.125rem; font-weight: 600; margin: 0 0 4px; } .ds-callout-body { font-size: 0.875rem; margin: 0; }

components.name: Warning Callout
components.description: Flat, left-bordered strip flagging a non-fatal calculator condition.
components.html: AF is 0.8 (≤ 1). This condition is not accelerating.
components.css: .ds-callout-warning { background: #fffbeb; border-left: 4px solid #f59e0b; color: #92400e; border-radius: 4px; padding: 12px 16px; font-size: 0.875rem; }

components.name: Error Callout
components.description: Flat, left-bordered strip for field validation or invalid physical results.
components.html: Please fix input validation errors.
components.css: .ds-callout-error { background: #fef2f2; border-left: 4px solid #ef4444; color: #b91c1c; border-radius: 4px; padding: 12px 16px; font-size: 0.875rem; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Numeric input field used across all calculators.
components.css: .ds-field { display: block; font-size: 0.875rem; color: #0f172a; } .ds-field-label { display: block; margin-bottom: 4px; } .ds-field-input { width: 100%; border: 1px solid #e2e8f0; border-radius: 6px; padding: 8px; font-size: 1rem; background: #ffffff; transition: border-color 150ms ease, box-shadow 150ms ease; } .ds-field-input:focus { outline: none; border-color: #2563eb; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #bfdbfe; }

components.name: Nav Item
components.description: Sidebar navigation link, default and active state.
components.html: ToolsResources
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px; font-size: 0.875rem; } .ds-nav-item { display: block; padding: 8px 12px; border-radius: 8px; color: #334155; text-decoration: none; border: 1px solid transparent; transition: background 150ms ease; } .ds-nav-item:hover { background: #f8fafc; } .ds-nav-item-active { background: #eff6ff; color: #1d4ed8; border-color: #bfdbfe; }

components.name: Wizard Step Dot
components.description: Numbered circular step indicator used in multi-step wizards (HALT/HASS, Burn-In).
components.css: .ds-stepper { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 16px; } .ds-step { width: 32px; height: 32px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; border-radius: 9999px; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 700; background: #cbd5e1; color: #334155; } .ds-step-active { background: #3b82f6; color: #ffffff; }

narrative.overview:
Reliatools reads like the display panel of a piece of lab test equipment: precise, calm, and built to be trusted under scrutiny rather than to impress. Most of the interface is deliberately quiet — white surfaces, restrained slate type, thin hairline borders — so that when the accent color appears, it means something: a value being measured, a state being flagged, an action being offered. Signal Blue (#2563eb) is that instrument's single active signal color, echoing an oscilloscope trace or a status LED. The homepage's animated logo (concentric rings, a scanning sweep line, pulsing circuit nodes, all in blue) is this identity's one permitted piece of literal theater; it names the metaphor the rest of the system stays quiet about.

The system is not neutral-flat everywhere. Interactive surfaces — cards, nav items, primary actions — are meant to feel physically liftable: a resting shadow-sm state that promotes to a deeper, cooler-toned shadow with a real upward translation on hover/focus, closer to a confident SaaS product than a static spec sheet. Inline calculation output, by contrast (results, warnings, errors), stays flat — colored left-border callout strips, not cards — because that content behaves like an instrument readout, not an interactive object.
keyCharacteristics: One accent color (Signal Blue) carrying all interactivity, emphasis, and brand signal; nothing else competes with it.
Neutral scale is slate, not gray — cooler, slightly blue-leaning, consistent with the accent.
Flat, left-border callout strips for calculated results/warnings/errors; shadowed, lifting cards for everything the user can click or navigate.
Geist Sans throughout; no serif, no display-only webfont.
KaTeX-rendered formulas are a first-class visual element on every tool page, not an afterthought.
One expressive motion signature (the diagnostic-pulse logo); everywhere else motion is a state-transition utility, not a decoration.

rules.name: The One-Signal Rule
rules.body: Signal Blue is the only accent color in the system. It never shares emphasis duty with a second brand hue; when a second color appears, it is always semantic (warning amber, danger red), never decorative.

rules.name: The Slate-Not-Gray Rule
rules.body: Neutrals are drawn from the slate scale, not gray. Some older tool-calculator pages still use Tailwind's gray-* scale (a documented inconsistency, not the standard) — treat any gray-* neutral found in existing code as drift to converge toward slate-* on next touch, not as a second accepted register.

rules.name: The Formula-Is-Type Rule
rules.body: KaTeX-rendered equations are treated as first-class typographic elements, not images — they sit inline with body copy at matching visual weight, inside the same slate-surface reference boxes as their variable-definition lists.

rules.name: The Readout-Stays-Flat Rule
rules.body: Anything the calculator computed (a result, a warning, an error) is presented flat with a colored left border, never inside a shadowed card. Shadows are earned by interactivity, not by importance.

dos: Do keep Signal Blue (#2563eb) as the only accent color; every other hue in the system is semantic (amber warning, red danger) or structural (slate neutrals).
Do use the slate neutral scale (slate-50 … slate-950) as canonical going forward, even where existing tool pages still use gray-*.
Do render calculated output (results, warnings, errors) as flat, left-bordered callout strips — never inside a shadowed card.
Do give interactive cards and buttons a real hover/focus promotion: deeper shadow plus a small upward lift, not just a border-color change.
Do treat the diagnostic-pulse animated logo as the system's single reserved moment of motion theater; respect prefers-reduced-motion on any new motion, following its existing pattern.
Do keep KaTeX formula blocks inside slate-surface reference boxes alongside their variable-definition lists, on every calculator page.
donts: Don't introduce a second brand accent color alongside Signal Blue; new emphasis needs are a weight/size/spacing problem, not a new-hue problem.
Don't put a card-style shadow on a results/warnings/errors callout — that visually confuses "computed readout" with "clickable object."
Don't reuse the hero logo's tinted blue glow (shadow-blue-100/60) on ordinary UI cards; it's reserved for that one signature moment.

Don't treat the shadcn/components/ui CSS-variable theme (currently only consumed by components/ui/card.tsx) as the system's real token source — the actually-operative palette is the Tailwind slate/blue utility values documented above; that CSS-variable layer is legacy scaffolding, not the source of truth.
